mapper.select: SELECT a.owner_id,a.session_id,a.question_id,a.id AS answer_id,s.mode, q.source_question_id,q.source_version_id,q.question_kind,a.version_number AS answer_number, a.answer_condition,a.assistance_event_sequence, JSON_OBJECT('authoredCount',JSON_EXTRACT(a.exposure_json,'$.authoredCount'), 'referenceViewCount',JSON_EXTRACT(a.exposure_json,'$.referenceViewCount'), 'lastExposureAt',JSON_EXTRACT(a.exposure_json,'$.lastExposureAt'), 'evaluationAccessCount',JSON_EXTRACT(a.exposure_json,'$.evaluationAccessCount')) AS exposure_json, a.created_at AS answer_created_at, SHA2(CAST(CONVERT(a.content_json USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY),256) AS content_fingerprint, SHA2(CAST(CONVERT(q.snapshot_json USING utf8mb4) AS BINARY),256) AS snapshot_fingerprint, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology'))='STRING' AND CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology')))<=2000 THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology')) ELSE NULL END AS technology, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario'))='STRING' AND CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario')))<=2000 THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario')) ELSE NULL END AS scenario, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions'))='STRING' AND CHAR_LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions')))<=5000 THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions')) ELSE NULL END AS question_conditions, REGEXP_LIKE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology')),'[^[:space:]]') AS technology_recorded, REGEXP_LIKE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario')),'[^[:space:]]') AS scenario_recorded, REGEXP_LIKE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions')),'[^[:space:]]') AS conditions_recorded, COALESCE(JSON_TYPE(a.content_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(q.snapshot_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content'))='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.sourceQuestionId'))='STRING' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.sourceQuestionId')) AS BINARY)=CAST(q.source_question_id AS BINARY) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.sourceVersionId'))='STRING' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.sourceVersionId')) AS BINARY)=CAST(q.source_version_id AS BINARY) AND JSON_TYPE(a.exposure_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.exposure_json,'$.authoredCount'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.exposure_json,'$.referenceViewCount'))='INTEGER',FALSE) AS metadata_valid FROM training_answer a JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.session_id=a.session_id AND q.id=a.question_id JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.session_id=#{sessionId} AND a.question_id=#{questionId} AND a.id=#{answerId}
